# Mac app — Composer and transcript

## Composer

![Composer](data:image/webp;base64,)

### ComposerStyle.swift
- ComposerShell r12 default: surface → bg on focus/drag, lineStrong stroke, wash ring; drag-over: bg .85 overlay "Drop to attach" paperclip 13 medium fg2
- ComposerHints: "⇥ use suggestion" "↵ send" "⌘↵ newline" "/ commands" "@ files" 11.5 fg4 gap 14
- AttachButton: paperclip 15 icon button 30
- PickerPill: lead 24, name fg, "· secondary" fg4, chevronDown 13 fg4; 12.5 medium; pl4 pr10 h32 max 240; surface2 → surface3 hover
- PillIcon 14 fg3; PillAvatar 24 surface2 disc, 10 medium rounded fg2

### ComposerView.swift (reply composer)
- host: maxW 896, pad h24 top4 bottom16
- stack: ErrorNote(s) above, gap 8; shell r12 composerShell
- inside: AttachmentStrip (if files), text view (placeholder: suggestion or 'Reply…'/busy text), attach error 12 fg, footer, SlashHint
- footer (wrap layout gap 6): AttachButton, DictateButton (mic), ThreadRunPills, ThreadPRSlot, [ComposerHints + Send/Steer] trailing gap 10; pad h8 bottom8 top6
- ThreadRunPills (fixed): 'bolt' 11.5 fg3 + model 12.5 medium + '· Claude Code' fg4; 'slider.horizontal.3' + effort; pad h10 h28 surface2 capsule; help 'Fixed for this thread'
- ThreadPRSlot: menu label: pull icon + '#128' 12.5 + PRChip(open ok / merged info / outline) + '+1' fg4, h26 fg3; or ghost pill 28 'Open PR' (pr icon 14)
- SendButton: 34 circle fg bg, send icon 16 w2 onInk; opacity .25 unarmed; press .92; Loader when sending
- SteerButton: ink capsule: send/clock 16 + 'Steer'/'Queue' 13 medium pl14 pr10 h34 | 1px onInk@.25 divider | chevronDown 13 w32 menu (Steer paperplane, Queue clock, Interrupt & send stop.fill)
- AttachmentStrip: chips h44 surface2 r16 pad 4; Thumb 36 r8 bg + line stroke (file 15 fg3 or image); name 12.5 medium fg2 (max 170) + size 10.5 fg4; x 13 icon button 24; strip pad h12 top12 bottom2 gap 6
- InterruptButton (toolbar): 'Interrupt' stop.fill / Loader 13 'Interrupting'

### SlashMenuView.swift
- menu: elev bg r22 menuShadow, maxH 352, pad 6, sits 8 above composer
- section caption pad h12 top8 bottom4
- SlashRow: '/name' 13 medium mono fg + argHint 12 mono fg4; desc 11.5 fg4; source tag 11 fg3 surface2 capsule pad h8; pad h12 v6 minH40 r16 wash when active
- FileRow: doc 13 fg3, name 13 medium fg, detail 11.5 fg4 (truncate head), 'artifact' tag
- notes: 'Loading commands' (Loader 13) / 'Couldn't read the commands. Run `x` in a terminal to see why.' 12.5 fg3 pad 12x10
- SlashHintView: hint 12 fg3 + 'New thread on another model' medium fg2 link

### NewThreadView.swift
- NewThreadScreen: column 768 pad h24 top56 (channel 24) bottom48; greeting on home
- composer shell r12; text 16 (big) / 14.5, height 96–360 big / 60–260; placeholder 'Describe the task' / 'Ask the Conductor anything. It delegates to the crew.'
- footer: Channel PickerPill (letter avatar or target icon), Role PickerPill ('No role' x icon; conductor ring StaticMark on bg avatar), ModelPickerButton (HarnessLogo 13 on bg avatar; 'Opus 4.1 · Claude Code'), EffortMenu (sliders icon; 'Auto effort' disabled .45), AttachButton, FolderChip, DictateButton, [Hints + SendButton 'Start']
- role description below 12 fg3 pad h16 bottom10
- Model popover w340 elev: search field (search 15 fg4 + 'Find a model or harness' 13) h40 surface r16 pad 6; group header: HarnessLogo 12 + name caption, right 'Bills your Max plan'/'Unavailable' 11.5 fg4; rows minH40 pad 8x6: HarnessLogo 13 in 28 surface2 circle, label 13 fg + ' (default)' fg4, note 11.5 fg4, PickMark; unavailable: 'Not available. Run `claude login`.' 11.5 fg4; 'No match'
- PickMark: 18 r6, lineStrong stroke 1.5 / fg fill + check 12 w2.4 onInk
- FolderChip: folder 13 fg3 + name + x 12 fg4; 12.5 fg2 (hover fg + wash bg); pad h10 h30 capsule

### Dictation.swift
- DictateButton (only if Wispr Flow installed): mic / mic.fill (needs color, pulse) icon button 30 active

## Transcript

![Transcript](data:image/webp;base64,)

### TranscriptStyle.swift
- tool icons: Bash→terminal, Read/Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Glob/Grep→file, Web*→globe, Task/Agent→layers, else tool
- Chevron right 12 fg4 rotates 90

### LinkChips.swift
- inline link chip in markdown: source mark (1.05em), thin space, muted ref (fg3) + title for bare URL

### MessageViews.swift
- UserBubble: right aligned, max 600; header (11.5 fg3): source label medium (conductor = live), send label w/ icon (send / stop for interrupt) medium, 'Not sent' x, clock 11 fg4; gap 5
- bubble: surface2, radii 22/22/22 top-trailing 8; text 14.5 line spacing 5 fg; pad 16x10; slash command pill inline 13 medium mono surface3 bg (click shows description below hairline: 12.5 fg3 + ' · tag' fg4); 'Show all'/'Show less' 12 medium fg3 underlined; dropped: dashed lineStrong 4/3, opacity .6
- IconLabel: icon 11 + text gap 4
- AttachmentsView (right-aligned flow gap 6): image thumb max 224x176 r12 line stroke inside pad 4 surface r16; file chip: file 15 in 32 bg r8, name 12.5 medium fg2 + size 10.5 fg4, download 14 fg3, pad h8 h44 surface r16
- ResultLine: hairline — [dot/diamond] sentence 12 medium fg4 (bad: needs diamond 8, fg2; ok: volt 5 dot w/ edge .5; else fg4 4 dot) — hairline; gap 12 pv4
- ErrorCallout: needs glyph 9 + 'Error' 12.5 semibold fg; text 11.5 mono fg2 line 3; pad 16x12 surface r20
- ReportCard: surface r22; header: inbox 14 fg3 in 28 bg circle, 'Report from researcher' medium fg, 'Not delivered' 11.5 medium fg3, task id 11.5 mono fg3, '#channel' fg3 link, spacer, StatusPill, 'Open thread →' 12.5 medium fg pad12 h28 bg capsule cardShadow; pad h16 top12; title 15 medium pt12; markdown pad 16 top8 bottom16; dropped .6
- PlanCard: surface r22 pad 16/14/12; header caption 'Plan' + TicksView maxW160 h6 + 'done/total' 11 fg3; CheckItems; 'All done' 12 fg4
- TicksView: bars gap2 r1.5, on fg full height, off fg@.14 55% height
- WorkingLine: Loader 13 fg3 + text 12.5 fg3
- QueuedMessages: right-aligned stack gap12; crew report queued: IconLabel 12 (send/clock) 12 fg3 left
- PendingBubble: label IconLabel 12 (clock/send) 11.5 medium fg3 + '· 2 files' fg4; dashed bubble (lineStrong 4/3, radii 22/8) 14 fg; opacity .7
- PendingRow actions (gap 4): arrowUp/arrowDown icon buttons 28, ghost pills 28 'Edit' (pencil 13) 'Remove' (trash)
- PendingEditBox: 'Editing · Queued' IconLabel pencil; box pad 10 surface r18 lineStrong stroke max600: OmniTextEditor min64, file chips (file 13 + name 12 medium fg2 + size 10.5 fg4 + x 22 icon btn; pl10 pr2 h30 surface2 capsule), paperclip icon 28 | spacer | ghost Cancel | primary 'Save' (check); error 12 needs
- StaleEdits: alert IconLabel 11.5 medium needs; surface2 bubble; ghost Copy (copy), secondary 'Send as new' (send), ghost Dismiss (x)
- ParkedMessages: hairline; heading 12 fg3 + primary 'Resume 2' (play); per row Send again (secondary, send) / Discard (ghost trash)

### MarkdownView.swift
- base 14.5, line spacing size*.6; gap 9; h1 *1.35 medium, h2 *1.18 medium, h3+ base semibold; pt6
- code block: 12.5 mono line 4 pad 14x12 surface r14 line stroke, horizontal scroll
- quote: 2px lineStrong bar + fg2; list: '•' / '1.' fg4 marker, checkbox square / checkmark.square.fill; table: head medium fg3, 13 cells, hairlines, cap 360
- hr Hairline pv8; links underlined fg

### ImageZoom.swift
- ImageZoomControls: minus icon 30, '100%' 11 fg3 w40, plus icon 30, ghost 30 'Fit'
- image: rounded 12, shadow .15 r6 y2, pad 12; cursors zoom-in/out

## Tool calls

![Tool calls](data:image/webp;base64,)

### ToolViews.swift
- ToolGroup card: surface r20; header h40 pad h14: Chevron, tool 13 fg3, '6 tool calls' medium fg2, names summary fg3 (live: latest label + summary in mono 11.5), needs glyph 7 + '1 failed' 11 fg, '2 agents running' 11 live, Loader 11; rowHover r20 (wash); open: rows pad h6 bottom6
- ToolRow: h32 pad h10 rowHover r16; Chevron, tool icon 13 fg3, label medium fg2 12.5, summary 12.5 fg3 (mono 11.5 for Bash/Read/etc), '3 sub-calls' 11 fg4, Loader 11 (live for agent / fg3 pending), needs 7 + 'error' 11 fg, 'stopped' 11 fg4
- nested: indent 14 + 1px line + 10
- ToolDetail pl28 pr4 pt4 pb10 gap6: input + Pre output ('(no output)', bad tone); 'Output truncated' 11 fg4; 'Waiting for result'/'No result recorded' 11.5 fg4
- ToolInput: bash desc 12 fg3 + Pre(command); edits: path 11.5 mono fg3 + Pre(old, delete) + Pre(new, add); write: 'file (42 lines)' + Pre add; prompt; todos CheckItems; json
- CheckItem: box 18 r6 stroke 1.5 (fg@.28 / fg active), done fills fg + tick stroke 2 onInk (M5 12.5 l4.5 4.5 L19 7.5); active: live dot 7 pulsing (.45/.82 0.7s); label 13.5 (medium active), fg2 / fg active / fg4 struck done; gap 10 pv3
- rowHover: wash bg on hover
